Abandoned or transferred intents recover through the existing operation-owner lease and reaper lifecycle, while run-20 exclusive serialization, run-22 quorum-spread ordering, remove safety, topology fences, numeric budgets, and the 60-second formation bar remain unchanged. Deterministic evidence proves bounded admission under a continuous newcomer stream and red-on-revert safety controls; the unchanged five-node MovieLens formation gate then reaches 5/5 ACTIVE within 60 seconds.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The waiting turn must be represented by the existing durable replica-operation intent and operation-owner lifecycle so every coordinator can observe it. Do not use a coordinator-local waiter boolean, process-local TTL, secondary queue, or new metadata store as the authority.

Persisting a PENDING intent is not permission to reconfigure the ledger. The physical ADD/REMOVE/REPLACE dispatch must remain fail-closed until an authoritative incomplete-operation observation proves that no other live operation conflicts; unreadable or deferred visibility keeps dispatch parked.

Keep the run-20 rule that a disruptive ledger self-move never overlaps another live operation and that later dependent operations defer while the durable self-move intent is live. Keep the run-22 quorum-spread hold and emergency ADD exemption unchanged.

Cancellation, ownership transfer, retry, timeout, and terminal cleanup must reuse canonical operation-owner lease and recovery/reaper transitions; no raw age check may delete or bypass a waiting intent.

Because this changes a fairness boundary, extend or add the smallest TLA+ contract that distinguishes reader-preference starvation from a durable waiting-writer turn, and run npm run model:contracts. The model does not replace deterministic or live evidence.

The focused deterministic guard must fail on current HEAD because a continuous finite newcomer stream overtakes the ledger self-move, then pass only when the durable intent blocks newcomers, incumbents drain, and dispatch occurs without overlap. Existing run-20, run-22, stale-ghost, terminal-hold, and remove-safety guards must remain green.
Do not alter formation timeouts, polling or retry cadence, numeric operation budgets, workload, cluster size, node activation predicates, remove safety, topology fences, or GCP runner ordering.

After deterministic proof, source verification, and checkpoint, run the unchanged dedicated five-node GCP formation/profile gate once. Stop on the first red result and diagnose the newly reached boundary before any rerun.
